{"consolidated_memory":"CORRUPTED SCAFFOLD IN cli/commands/init.py — THREE SEPARATE INCIDENTS

All three incidents involved the same symptom in the init command (developer tooling): a generated tree missing one file when initializing into a directory that already has a lockfile.

**INCIDENT 1: [2026-04-16]**
- Trigger: rolling restart of the fleet
- Root cause: N+1 query hidden behind a lazy relation
- Fix: prefetched the relation in a single query
- PR #1454 on branch fix/corrupted-scaffold-2
- Measured outcome: reclaimed 64 GB of blob storage

**INCIDENT 2: [2026-07-03]**
- Trigger: staging read replica (issue appeared only there)
- Root cause: clock skew between the two hosts
- Fix: switched the deadline to a monotonic clock
- PR #2436 on branch fix/corrupted-scaffold-3
- Measured outcome: cold start performance dropped 62 percent, to 113 ms

**INCIDENT 3: [2026-08-02]**
- Trigger: traffic arriving through the corporate proxy
- Root cause: two writes that were never wrapped in a transaction
- Fix: wrapped both writes in one transaction
- PR #4232 on branch fix/corrupted-scaffold-4
- Measured outcome: throughput rose 94 percent, to 467 requests per second

All three fixes were applied to the same corner of cli/commands/init.py; context from earlier corrupted scaffold work carried over between incidents."}
